table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	VisitCode = V.VisitCode,
	VisitDate = V.Date,
	VisitType = (SELECT VT.Name FROM VisitType VT WHERE VT.VisitTypeCode = V.VisitTypeCode),
	PatientRegNo = P.RegNo,
	PatientName = CASE V.PatientCode WHEN NULL THEN V.PatientDetails ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(P.Name)) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.RegNo)) + ')' END,
	PatientGender = P.Gender,
	PatientPhone = P.Phone,
	Age = DATEDIFF(YYYY, P.DOB, V.Date),
	Height = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.Height1))) + ' ' + VV.HeightUnit1 + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL(VV.Height2,'0')))) + ' ' + VV.HeightUnit2,
	Weight = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.Weight1))) + ' ' + VV.WeightUnit1 + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL(VV.Weight2, '0')))) + ' ' + VV.WeightUnit2,
	PulseRate = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.PulseRate))),
	RespirationRate = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.Respiration))),
	Temperature = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.TemperatureValue))) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(VV.TemperatureUnit)),
	BP = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.BloodPressureSysTolic))) + '/' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(VV.BloodPressureDiaSTolic))),
	PreviousDiagnosis = V.PreviousDiagnosis,
	Diagnosis = V.Diagnosis,
	Recommendations = V.Recommendations,
	Remarks = V.Remarks,
	FollowUpDate = V.Date + V.FollowUpDays,
	Doctor = (SELECT D.Name FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Title1 = (SELECT D.Title1 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Title2 = (SELECT D.Title2 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Title3 = (SELECT D.Title3 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Title4 = (SELECT D.Title4 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Footer1 = (SELECT D.Footer1 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Footer2 = (SELECT D.Footer2 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Footer3 = (SELECT D.Footer3 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	Footer4 = (SELECT D.Footer4 FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = V.DoctCode),
	DM = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 1), 0),
	HTN = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 2), 0),
	Smoking = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 3), 0),
	Obesity = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 4), 0),
	FamilyHistory = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 5), 0),

	COPD = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 6), 0),
	ASTHMA = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 7), 0),
	CUA = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 8), 0),
	CKD = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 9), 0),
	Alergy = ISNULL((SELECT 1 FROM VisitPrecaution VP WHERE VP.VisitCode = V.VisitCode AND VP.PrecautionCode = 10), 0)
FROM
	Visit V
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient AS P ON (V.PatientCode = P.PatientCode),
	VisitVitals VV
WHERE
	V.VisitCode = :ai_code AND
	V.VisitCode = VV.VisitCode
